title: Do you have good dining etiquette?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which table manners do you consider essential, and which do you not care about?
How should you behave when dining customs in another culture are unfamiliar to you?
Is using a phone at the table always rude?
Should parents insist that children follow formal dining etiquette at home?
What dining behaviour would make you uncomfortable even if the food and company were excellent?
